subject: Re: SOC 2 packet & next steps — FinTechCo discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Reed <t.reed@fintechco.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: FinTechCo discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Tom / Sophie,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and agreed next steps: 

- Key pain: unpredictable inference costs and occasional latency spikes on peak hour models.
- What we showed: Redwood inference runtime, routing policies (latency-first vs cost-first), and Dedicated capacity options.
- Ask from you: procurement window, security/assessment contacts, and a short prioritized list of models/workloads you'd like to pilot.

Next steps we agreed on:
1) I will send our SOC 2 packet and a short security summary for your infosec team (ETA: EOD tomorrow).
2) Rishi will reach out to map throughput requirements if you want a Dedicated sizing exercise.
3) Tom/Sophie — if you're open, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the security packet and confirm rollout priorities.

If that matches your notes, I'll send over the SOC 2 pack and a proposed slot for next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

--
P.S. Looping Rishi for sizing as discussed.
